raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE Associate - Cognizant June 2023 -Present • Execute and monitor trade settlements across multiple settlement platforms, ensuring all transactions are processed accurately and in line with client agreements and trade obligations.
Used Bloomberg Terminal to retrieve and verify market prices for securities using CUSIP identifiers. •
Ensure timely settlement of securities and cash through systems such as Euroclear, Clearstream, DTC, while adhering to market deadlines and SLAs. Perform trade matching and confirmation with internal systems, custodians, and counterparties to ensure all trade details are accurately aligned before settlement. Investigate, analyze, and resolve settlement discrepancies and trade breaks between internal records, custodians, and external counterparties, ensuring complete reconciliation. Ensure all unsettled or failed trades are tracked, escalated where necessary, and resolved within defined operational SLAs.

• Act as a point of contact for clients, traders, custodians, and internal stakeholders for trade-related queries, confirmations, and issue


resolution. Provide high-quality client servicing by responding to inquiries in a timely, professional manner and ensuring transparency in settlement status and issues. Support business identification and participate as a subject matter expert in discussions related to process improvements, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies. Identify operational risks, process gaps, and recurring settlement issues; recommend and help implement process improvements to reduce trade breaks and increase efficiency.
Maintain accurate records of all trade lifecycle activities, ensuring audit readiness and compliance with internal controls and regulatory
requirements. Collaborate with senior stakeholders, trading desks, operations teams, and technology teams to ensure smooth end-to-end settlement processing 
Consultant - Deloitte Aug 2022– May 2023 • Managed post-market FX trade reconciliation, ensuring all positions are accurately booked and settled. • Reconciled GBS Spot Position (SPOS) breaks and internal trade suspense/clearance accounts, identifying and resolving discrepancies. • • Allocated work, reviewed pending breaks, and managed escalated break resolutions in coordination with relevant teams. • Performed middle-office reconciliation for in-house clearance accounts within Barclays. • Executed front-office to back-office and back-office to back-office reconciliations across internal accounts. • Handled end-to-end FX break processing across multiple account types, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution. •
Conducted break itemization and analysis, reviewing nature of breaks and implementing corrective actions.
Led an ad-hoc project to set up correct Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), updating 3000+ CP-SSI instructions to enable STP (Straight- Through Processing) and ensure fast, accurate fund transfers via clearing/agent banks to ultimate beneficiaries.
Senior Analyst - State Street HCL Nov 2019 – April 2022 • Managed End-to-End Trade Booking & Reconciliation ensuring SLA compliance
• Accurate Trade & Cash Accounting Entries with proper documentation

Performed Cash & Position Reconciliation with brokers/counterparties
Handled Query Resolution & Break Management across teams
Resolved reconciliation breaks ensuring timely closure

Identified & escalated Operational Risk issues

Supported Audit requirements & reporting (Error Tracker, Break Log)
Delivered Month/Quarter-End activities within tight deadline.
raw_sections.awards:
Achievements: Received recognition and appreciation from clients and senior management for accurate trade processing and timely issue resolution.

Achievements: • Promoted to Senior Analyst for exceptional performance in reconciliation and trade lifecycle management and maintaining seamless collaboration with global stakeholders.
Supported Client Servicing, Audit Requirements, and Knowledge Transfer for new joiners
